summary: Restore transported textarea/select values after sanitized child construction.
diagnosis: The complete guest serializer encodes assigned control.value into a value attribute. Browsers do not reflect that attribute into textarea/select.value. The previous sanitizer copied attributes and children, leaving blank textarea/first-option select on initial display and every update.
correction: After copying allowed attributes and sanitizing/appending children, restore textarea/select.value only when the source has a value attribute. This preserves explicit empty values and lets native select semantics match the completed sanitized option list; unmatched values leave no selection. No HTML parsing is added for the value string.
